quotes.speaker: Norchad Omier
quotes.summary_phrase: Norchad Omier on his late start to playing basketball
quotes.excerpt: I started playing basketball pretty late. When I start playing, I think I was 14 years old.
quotes.quote: I started playing basketball pretty late. When I start playing, I think I was 14 years old. All I did was rebound and pass the ball to who know who to play basketball. I couldn't dribble, I couldn't do anything, so I think that stick with me since then.
quotes.social_post: Norchad Omier on his basketball journey: I started playing late at 14. All I did was rebound and pass the ball to people who knew how to play because I could not dribble.

structured.context: Norchad Omier reflects on his late start in basketball and how his early focus on rebounding shaped his game.

quotes.speaker: Norchad Omier
quotes.summary_phrase: Norchad Omier on being the first Nicaraguan player in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: I am so happy now that kids see that it is not just baseball.
quotes.quote: I am so happy now that kids see that it is not just baseball. In Nicaragua we play a lot of baseball, but they see that it is not just baseball, they can achieve their dreams in basketball. A lot of basketball is being played in Nicaragua now, so I am very happy about that.
quotes.social_post: Norchad Omier on being the first Nicaraguan player in the NBA: I am happy kids see it is not just baseball. They can achieve their dreams in basketball too.

structured.context: Norchad Omier discusses the significance of being the first Nicaraguan player in the NBA.
